image_description: A tabby cat lying on its side on a paved concrete surface. The cat appears to be resting or sleeping, with its body curled slightly. The coat displays distinct tabby markings including stripes on the legs and torso, and an M-shaped marking is visible on the forehead. The fur texture looks realistic with variations in color from grey to brown/tawny.

The anatomy of the right hind paw is somewhat obscured by the angle and fur, but the connection to the leg lacks clear structural definition, appearing slightly 'mushy' or melted into the ground shadow.
